Name: Shardust's Wallpapers and Floors for Content Patcher
Author: Shardust
Description:
After a 'brief' interlude with the greyscale (my hair mods) I have returned to the wonderful world of colors.

Allow me to present additional custom walls and floors for Content Patcher. They will be available from Pierre's Catalogue, and will not overwrite the vanilla textures, so you can have them all.
There are 12 walls with 24 colors each (total 288), and 6 floors with 24 colors each (total 144).
(There will be updates with more patterns in the following months)

I know that 12/6 seems such a low number, but each one has, again, -24- colors options, because I wanted them to match my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3751]Dynamic interior mod[/url].
I do plan on more patterns, but it will take a while.
(I might also do a recolor of some of the vanilla walls/floors eventually, at a later time)

Thanks for checking out my mods!
